cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've selected the club's new pianist. You may congratulate me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I hear an audition before I approve the booking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I've granted you the first table at tonight's paid performance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You signed a contract without me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may inspect my signature after you've written "approved" beside it. Then we'll both have contributed.

relationship.evidence: B2 has an explicit approval role and B4 challenges being bypassed, giving A's dependence real stakes.

heightening.evidence: B4 contract challenge exposes completed commitment; A5 turns inspection of the evidence into another privilege conditional on retroactive consent.
